name: jevgate
description: Jev-backed gates for Claude Code: bash guard for bypass mode, file guard, done-check, subagent gate, verbatim compaction. Each feature toggles independently.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or settings env.

log.title: Full decisions log
log.description: Also log every decision in full (commands, file paths, Jev's facts and scores) to decisions-v2.jsonl in the plugin data dir. The stats behind the footer and /jevgate are kept either way, without commands or paths.

bashEnabled.title: Bash guard
bashEnabled.description: Judge shell commands: read-only commands from Claude Code's own free set run without asking Jev; everything else gets one Jev call that reports facts, and the rules decide allow, ask or deny.

bashRecentTurns.title: Guard: recent turns
bashRecentTurns.description: How many of the latest conversation turns (user and assistant) Jev sees when judging whether a command or write exceeds the request.

fileEnabled.title: File guard
fileEnabled.description: Edit/Write/Read guard. Writes inside the project are free; a write outside it is judged by Jev; a read of a credential path is refused.

hitMin.title: Guards: flag at
hitMin.description: Probability at which a fact counts: for a choice, an option plus the stricter ones summed; for yes/no facts, yes at or above. Re-measure with scripts/probe-facts.ts before changing.

noneMin.title: Guards: nothing-happened at
noneMin.description: Probability of 'none' Jev must give before a fact counts as not happening; between the two thresholds the fact is unsure.

requestedMin.title: Guards: asked-for at
requestedMin.description: Probability at which a command counts as asked for.

unrequestedMax.title: Guards: not-asked-for at
unrequestedMax.description: Probability at or below which a command counts as not asked for: then it is asked, and a flagged one is refused. Between this and requestedMin nothing changes.

unsureOutcome.title: Guards: when Jev is unsure
unsureOutcome.description: allow, ask or deny when a fact is unsure.

knownHosts.title: Guards: your hosts
knownHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts you own (ssh aliases or domains). Uploads to them are not flagged.

rulesFile.title: Guards: rules file
rulesFile.description: Optional JSON file overriding the outcome per fact value, e.g. {"deletes": {"local_no_copy": "deny"}, "modes": {"auto": {...}}}.

doneEnabled.title: Done-check
doneEnabled.description: When Claude says it is done and the diff does not cover the request or the final message overclaims, send a follow-up prompt so Claude goes on.

doneCoverMin.title: Done-check: coverage to pass
doneCoverMin.description: Jev rates how much of the request the diff implements on a ladder: 0 none, 1 a small part, 2 most, 3 all. Below this a follow-up names the rung.

doneMaxBlocks.title: Done-check max follow-ups
doneMaxBlocks.description: Follow-ups per request before letting Claude stop anyway.

agentEnabled.title: Subagent gate
agentEnabled.description: Deny a subagent spawn when the answer is already in the recent conversation.

agentThreshold.title: Subagent deny threshold
agentThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that the answer is already in context.

compactEnabled.title: Verbatim compaction
compactEnabled.description: Replace the compaction summary with the original messages, long tool outputs truncated. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

compactUseJev.title: Compaction: rank with Jev
compactUseJev.description: Ask Jev which truncated outputs to restore verbatim. Off means deterministic truncation only.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction trigger percent
compactAtPercent.description: Context usage at which jevgate asks whether to compact (trim, built-in summary, or not yet).

compactPreserveRecent.title: Compaction: recent messages pinned
compactPreserveRecent.description: Newest messages never truncated. The first message and all Edit/Write results are always pinned.

compactTruncateHeadChars.title: Compaction: head chars kept
compactTruncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a truncated tool output kept before the note.

compactRestoreTopK.title: Compaction: outputs restored
compactRestoreTopK.description: How many of the highest-scoring truncated outputs Jev may restore verbatim.

compactRestoreMinScore.title: Compaction: restore share
compactRestoreMinScore.description: Share of Jev's Choice probability an old tool output needs to be restored in full. Probabilities sum to 1 across all candidates plus 'none'.

compactRestoreMinConfidence.title: Compaction: restore confidence
compactRestoreMinConfidence.description: Jev's confidence in its ranking. Below this nothing is restored. 0 (default) disables the gate: confidence did not separate needed from stale in probes.

compactMinReductionRatio.title: Compaction: minimum reduction
compactMinReductionRatio.description: Below this fraction saved, the conversation is kept as is.
